item.title: B.C. driver asleep at wheel of Tesla, speeding down Highway 1 in rainy rush hour
item.description: Police in Metro Vancouver are warning drivers to remain attentive, even in a self-driving vehicle, after ticketing a woman who "appeared to be literally asleep at the wheel" on Highway 1.

item.title: CAF members reported safe after missile intercepted near Israel-Lebanon border
item.description: Defence Minister David McGuinty's office says Canada received reports of damage at a United Nations peacekeeping camp near the Israel Lebanon border after a missile was intercepted on Sunday.

item.title: Historic Snowbirds jet coming to BC Aviation Museum in North Saanich
item.description: The BC Aviation Museum in North Saanich says it will be adding a Canadair CT-114 Tutor to its collection, a jet made famous by the Canadian Forces Snowbirds.

item.title: First official humpback whale sighting of the season confirmed off Nanaimo
item.description: The first humpback whale of the 2026 season has been spotted just off Nanaimo, marking the start of the marine mammals' annual return to B.C. waters.

item.title: View Royal Fire Chief Paul Hurst to retire after more than 40 years of service
item.description: After more than four decades of service, View Royal Fire Chief Paul Hurst has announced he will retire effective Oct. 1, closing out a career that began when he was just a teenager.

item.title: Fatal parking lot crash in Nanaimo lands driver $1,000 in fines
item.description: A driver in a fatal crash in Nanaimo where an 85-year-old woman was killed while walking in a parking lot has been fined $1,000.

item.title: 'Targeting the most vulnerable': GVTA calls on board to cut administrative costs instead
item.description: The association says the province should shift the hundreds of millions it's positioned to give to private schools to the public system.

item.title: 'Forgotten population': People with special needs lose housing in Cowichan
item.description: A "shocking" funding cut has crushed plans to build affordable housing for people with special needs in the Cowichan Valley.

item.title: Future Luxton Fairgrounds revitalization dependent on more volunteers
item.description: The Metchosin Farmers' Institute is looking to give the historic Luxton Fairgrounds a facelift, however revitalization efforts are dependent on more volunteers.

item.title: 'We still don't know': Questions remain 20 years after Queen of the North sinking, says TSB head investigator
item.description: Reflecting on the fatal sinking of the MV Queen of the North, the former head of major investigations for the Transportation Safety Board says many lessons were learned.
